IS 170 : 2020 Acetone-Specification
ICS 71.080.80
PCD 09
Revised Standard from Last Update.
1 SCOPE
This standard prescribes the requirement, methods of sampling and test for acetone intended for industrial purposes.
2 REFERENCES
The following standards contain provisions, which through reference in this text constitute the provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most editions of the standards indicated below:
